body:
Advocates opening rifts and describes a hoped-for liberation through Tiamat.

Recorded role and choices

Vys introduces himself in the March 2025 confrontation and condemns Zarathian rule. He says dreams and visions guide his devotion to Tiamat and argues that larger rifts will further her purpose. These are his beliefs and proposed actions, not confirmation that the visions are true or that the plan succeeds. Vys remains distinct from Vysaeth; the short name and supplied image do not establish that they are one person.
